# S5.2 — Compaction family + split/composite tool surfaces (§5c, §5d.2)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.1` (PR #83) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the Stage-5 compaction family, the
split/composite/synthesized tool-surface family, the
context-policy family, similarity reranking and the
procedure-target residual under the `offline-only` budget
(`R-2.4.2`, `R-2.5.2`, `R-2.4.1¹`, `R-2.4.3²`, `R-2.4.5`).

**Compaction family** (`R-2.4.2`; `AC-R-2.4.2-6/-10`):
`hh-context` gains `compact_family.rs` —
`VariantDeclaration`/`check_variant_declaration` gate every
variant's declared inputs to `{ModelProfile,
ResourceAccount}` (model-identity conditions refuse at
declaration; a conditioned rule without a complete
`AssumptionDebtRecord` is inadmissible — ADR-0189's gate at
registration), and `resolve` walks the canonical rule order
by declared profile / runtime-compliance conditions only.
The closed `CompactionOp` sum gains `Restructure` and
`ProviderCompact`: `Restructure` executes through the
deterministic `CheckpointExtractor` port; `ProviderCompact`
delegates to a bound `ProviderCompaction` port whose summary
lands only in a `min_authority ≤ delegate` slot — and when
the provider cannot enumerate its forgotten set, the record
carries `forgotten = {range: "all_prior"}`, sweeping the
submitted blocks plus every non-`required` view item before
`insert_at` (I-REQ keeps required items delivered inside the
range; the marker still records the unreported loss). The
declared variants — `summarize_rolling`,
`offload_then_summarize`, `structured_checkpoint`,
`world_state_refresh`, `provider_compaction`,
`fresh_window_with_notes` — run the same
`check_proposal`/`execute` kernel as the C0 rungs.
`compaction_reminder` decodes through
`decode_compaction_reminder` into a profile-owned
`CompactionReminder` and mints a `reminder_candidate` at the
declared placement — never a kernel-invented notice.
`model_owned_ops`/`compact_model_owned` parse a
`ModelCompactCall` through a closed grammar into the same
`CompactionOp` sum and face I-REQ/I-NOWIDEN/I-CUT/I-RECLAIM
unchanged — no privileged model path; `summarizer_profile`/
`max_summary_tokens`/`input_reduction`/`instructions_ref`/
`restructure` ride the proposal as recorded metadata.

**Tool-surface family** (`R-2.5.2` C2; `AC-R-2.5.2-{3,4,5,8,9,10}`):
`hh-compiler` gains `family.rs` —
`SurfaceFamily`/`SurfaceVariant`/`VariantSelector` (a closed
grammar: `TaskClass`/`Environment`/`TurnField{declared}`/
`Any`/`All`/`Not`/`Always` — no model-identity member; an
undeclared turn field reads `false`, never a peek);
`check_family` requires a primitive/split
`reference_variant` and refuses bindings reaching outside
`capability_refs` (`AuthorityWidening`). `PlanMap` admits
exactly `Branch`/`Invoke`/`Verify` —
`Loop`/`Delegate`/`Opaque`/`Instruction` are
`UncheckableSurface` (code-mode by definition); every
`Invoke` names a member of `allowed_capabilities` (S1) and
`check_plan_map_evidence` runs E1–E7 per branch. The
canonical `str_replace_editor`/`unified_exec` fixtures ship
in the module. `split` expands one capability into N
surfaces at lower time (each mints its own `surface_id`,
binds its `const{value}` arg, drops its dropped args);
composite surfaces bind through `BindingMapping::PlanMap`.
`SchemaDialectTransform` declares every narrowing —
undeclared enum/invention/nullability loss refuses
`DialectNarrowingUndeclared` (`AC-R-2.5.2-5`); composite/
shim/code-mode/freeform members mint their declared MCP
`LossEntry` rows (`AC-R-2.5.2-4`). `check_safety` produces
`SafetyEvidence` over the S1–S4 gates (no authority
widening; composite ⇒ per-step nested mediation; labelled
synthesized text ≤ `delegate` and ≥ the slot floor; fail
closed); `synthesize_surface` admits only all-pass evidence
plus a *complete* debt record, naming the refusing gate
(`AC-R-2.5.2-8`); `retire_surface` leaves the residual rule
list the retirement experiment reads. `freeform` is one
`parse{grammar_ref}` arg-map entry; `code_mode` mints child
effects under `parent_effect_id`, `code_mode_catalogue`
admits only `code_mode`-hinted bindings, and
`CodeModeSandbox` cannot express credentials/ambient
authority (structural S2); `shim_resolve` is an exact name
table — a miss is `UnknownSurface`, never a best-effort
match — and `shim_metering` meters the interpreter call as
`model_call` under the calling role's token role.

**Context-policy family** (`R-2.4.1¹`; `AC-R-2.4.1-11`):
`hh-context` gains `policy_family.rs` — the five declared
variants (`priority_eviction`, `world_state_diff`,
`jit_handles`, `recency_plus_pins`, `retrieval_augmented`),
`DemotionWrapper` selection and reminder placement/rule
retirement. Demotion routes authority-inadmissible
candidates to an `external` slot only — never inward, never
upward, never a silent drop; the assembly outcome carries a
`Demotion{candidate_id, wrapper_id, target_slot, text_ref}`
per demoted candidate (`AssembleRequest.demotion_wrappers`
is additive). Profile-conditioned rules share the one
`{ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}` input check
(`policy.rs::check_conditioned_*`).

**Retrieval** (`R-2.4.3²`; `AC-R-2.4.3-10`):
`retrieve.rs` gains the `Embedder` port
(`embedder_ref`/`embed`), `similarity_rerank` (the request's
declared `embedder_ref` must equal the bound identity —
mismatch/unpinned refuses, never a substitute), integer-only
`cosine_ppm` (ppm arithmetic + integer sqrt — identical on
every host), `similarity_probe`, `RetrievalIndexes`/
`retrieve_indexed`, and `RetrievalReport.embedder_calls`
accounting with the non-deterministic mark.

**Skills residual** (`R-2.4.5`): `procedure.rs` consumes the
`procedure_target` profile rule — the declared target is
read at selection time (workflow_node/subagent_task/instruction
routing stays typed, never silently instruction).

**Lab** (`R-2.4.2` empirical half): the full
`lab/compaction-family-v1` constructor — five strategies,
the `window_ceiling` reference-only arm, `summarizer_profile`
as a model factor, the matched-cap budget, and the
conditioned-rule retirement companion arm.

## Acceptance

- `AC-R-2.4.1-11` — demotion wrappers route to `external`
  only; reminder placement + rule retirement.
- `AC-R-2.4.2-6` — conditioned rules resolve by declared
  profile/compliance, never identity; `compaction_reminder`
  is profile-owned.
- `AC-R-2.4.2-10` — model-owned ops parse to the same sum
  and face the same invariants.
- `AC-R-2.4.3-10` — pinned embedder, `embedder_calls`,
  integer-only scoring, non-deterministic mark.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-3` — family/selector/`PlanMap`, split +
  static composite, per-branch evidence; canonical fixtures.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-4` — declared MCP loss entries for the
  containerless modes.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-5` — dialect narrowings are declared or
  refused.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-8` — S1–S4 gates, `synthesize_surface`/
  `retire_surface`, fail closed with the gate named.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-9` — `freeform` parse map; `code_mode` nested
  effects, catalogue membership, sandbox declaration.
- `AC-R-2.5.2-10` — exact-table `shim` resolution;
  `UnknownSurface` miss; `model_call` metering.
- `removability(0…3)` — serial script green (all stanzas).
- Universal phase-gate AC — verification green; requirement
  ids stamped; ADR-0313 records the owned rulings;
  DEFERRALS/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER updated.
